# UI Review Rules

This repository contains contracts, theme definitions and assets, not an App.

- Check actual producer/consumer compatibility when integration evidence exists.
  Standalone schema validation is not cross-repository proof.
- Check theme identity, day/night roles, generated copies, font integrity and licenses.
- For prototype changes, review loading, empty, error, cancellation, accessibility
  and responsive states. Assets do not prove HarmonyOS rendering.
- Do not merge, publish or weaken gates during review.
